authored_rig.method: Authored spatial layers with nearest-segment blending; not recovered anatomy

motion_envelope.scope: Base skin at every authored key and midpoint, plus explicit fur margin; not continuous bounds or physics

color_corrections.fur_exclusion_scope: Exclude every returned vertex ID from native and portable fur sampling because the original root-color texture was not changed.
color_corrections.selection: Normalized world-bound face centroid inside any ellipsoid AND mean source RGB dominant channel strictly greater than ratio times maximum other channel.
color_corrections.texture_scope: Original image datablocks and UV routing are reused without pixel/file writes; selected face materials use an authored constant linear RGB instead of their Base Color texture link. This is not texture repainting or recovered hidden-surface color.

initialization.method: Particle Edit enter/exit on owned emitter

limitations: Apply once to a fresh groom in its rest pose; counts/topology changes can regenerate hair.
The vector is in emitter object axes; no panda-specific direction or recovered grooming.
Stored parent arc length follows explicit regional scale (otherwise preserved); children add configured roughness/clump variation.
Native Blender hair is not exported as glTF geometry or browser hair.
Hair follows the copied emitter's same armature; keep emitter topology unchanged after grooming.
The caller caps aggregate fibers at 240000 and excludes native groom objects from GLB selection.

native_parameters.radius_semantics: Input is authoring-space radius at unit meter scale; Blender multiplies diameter properties by radius_scale
native_parameters.root_radius_description: Strand diameter width at the root

groom.render_count_scope: Configured parents plus interpolated children; not an independently counted image feature

finish.motion_origin: Explicit locally authored actions; source provider clips are not used or relabeled

material.pattern: 3 curved fibers per tile; sixteen seeded tiles
material.root_color: Exact sampled triangle UV, sRGB texels decoded before bilinear interpolation; linear constant per tuft

binding_selection.allocation_policy: Hamilton largest remainder; uniform wins ties; when possible give each nonempty domain one root
binding_selection.normalization_policy: sort positive named influences; divide by math.fsum; exact tuple equality, no cutoff/tolerance
binding_selection.ordering_policy: original triangle index; stable draw/corner order within each face
binding_selection.uniform_sampling_policy: one seeded draw per cumulative-area stratum; open barycentric draws

root_summary.root_color_source: Exact emitter triangle UV callback; linear RGB constant per card

sampling.buffer_lifetime: Released when portable_coat returns, before native grooming
sampling.flow_bounds_scope: Entire rest emitter, identical to native groom copy
sampling.output_color_space: linear RGB after per-texel sRGB decode and bilinear filtering

source_contract.coordinates: Blender UVs paired with bottom-up image rows
source_contract.filter_scope: Bilinear LOD0 only; no mip or derivative equivalence

sampling.source_pixel_interpretation: Existing encoded-sRGB image.pixels convention; bottom-up rows
sampling.uv_source: Actual active UV corners of each selected loop triangle; never first-loop vertex UV

finish.portable_fur_build_order: Tuft cards and borrowed root-color buffer completed before native grooming

portable_fur_export_budget.scope: Conservative corner allowance, not measured export size or visible fur coverage

portable_fur_identity.identity_scope: IDs are local to each named mesh; bottom card endpoints are 6*r and 6*r+1

source_color_sampling.scope: CPU source-color selection sampling; importer, exporter and renderer image handling is separate.

states.deformation_diagnostic_scope: Sampled edge stretch with original normalized body coordinates and weights; diagnostic only, not visual acceptance or physics

weight_constraints.method: Bound provider bone weights to authored ellipsoids; transfer removed weight to the configured fallback bone

job.measurement_scope: Observed wall time and sampled direct-child RSS; descendant RSS is not measured

representations.browser: Skinned alpha-masked cards if configured; not native strands

authored_assumptions: Bone placement, skin weights and scale are locally authored; hidden geometry and motion are not physically verified
rig_verification.compatibility: Mapping checked against supplied target joint names only; target runtime not exercised.

motion.method: CPU linear-blend skinning at bounded key/midpoint samples

rig_verification.rest_pose: Default exported node transforms and inverse bind matrices; no physical validation implied
rig_verification.visual_review: required; materials/textures are not rendered by this validator

rights: User-described subject with optional selected references. Generated hidden surfaces and agent-authored rig, scale and motion are assumptions. Source provenance is retained by the pipeline; commercial rights are not independently verified.

states.meaning: A cheerful four-second toy dance with readable alternating side-to-side beats, small whole-body hops, coordinated arm swings, and head tilts, ending back in the starting neutral pose.

style: Cute stylized 3D avatar with short tidy black-and-ivory fur, rounded features, clean simple color boundaries and warm glossy brown eyes. The existing short-fur avatar quality is sufficient: prioritize consistent identity and a readable dance. Do not add long hair, accessories, realism or a new appearance-polishing pass.
subject: An original friendly upright panda-like character with compact rounded proportions, an ivory face and belly, black ears, black eye patches, black arms and legs, warm brown eyes, a short muzzle and a small black tail.
